cohort.source: multiresolution_experience_report_design prespecified Discovery stimulus-early/stimulus-late pair manifest

historical_K2_boundary.purpose_of_later_comparison: quantify how much inclusion of rating_early reorganized the earlier three-epoch family partition; never use the old labels to choose new K or centroids

multi_resolution_family_discovery.canonical_label_rule: lexicographic ordering of prespecified centroids in the fixed 14-cell signature coordinate order; never behavioral ordering
cross_resolution_outputs: ARI and NMI for every pair of eligible K resolutions
fine-to-coarse parent purity without assuming a tree
multi_resolution_family_discovery.no_eligible_K_rule: do not force discrete families; close the discrete experience-family branch and retain continuous reconfiguration signatures only

stability.comparison: adjusted Rand index versus the corresponding full Discovery K solution

next_after_discovery_stimulus_experience.if_at_least_one_K_eligible: validation_experience_transfer_design specifications Discovery templates/support thresholds and a one-shot Validation stimulus-only structural transfer before Validation signal values are opened
next_after_discovery_stimulus_experience.if_no_K_eligible: validation_experience_transfer_design records discrete-analysis conclusion and specifications a continuous experience/report dissociation route; no family taxonomy is invented

primary_question: Does stimulus_early to stimulus_late EEG reconfiguration contain stable cross-person structure when rating_early and all human labels are excluded from discovery?

cross_person_standardization: within each participant, robust-center every transformed signature cell by the participant median
divide by participant IQR; use Discovery participant-balanced pooled IQR only when local IQR <= 1e-8
participant_stage_preprocessing: for each participant and each stimulus epoch separately, median-impute each of the 169 compact cells using that participant/stage only
divide by that participant/stage feature IQR
if stage IQR <= 1e-8, use participant-pooled early+late IQR for the same feature
if pooled IQR also <= 1e-8, use scale 1.0 and record the feature as locally constant
representation.participant_weight: each participant contributes total weight 1 regardless of trial count

global: RMS displacement across all 169 compact cells
cosine similarity across all 169 compact cells
per_block: RMS displacement between standardized stimulus_early and stimulus_late profiles
cosine similarity between standardized stimulus_early and stimulus_late profiles
trial_signature.reason: captures both magnitude and feature-profile reconfiguration while remaining outcome-free and excluding rating-stage activity

scientific_role: Discovery-only outcome-free multi-resolution stimulus-experience reconfiguration discovery
